markdown: ## Watchlist - **UniCredit:** It reported record profit and is set to complete its Commerzbank takeover this month [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxORjZpV0hqX0owd3l2ZHZQbmNPR3dOdVh2OGpqcjhwNWFtZlRUaHJ6dS1PQTRMNHpTVHlwY3Z2eklMenlyT1pfcm9TdDRCT3FJOUNVLVdLdy1PTHhJcXFOYTZGOFY2V3psZWZzN0NudTdITlF3SWltanMtZVJpdVhmb29Ta3dTNTlheldTQS1kOHRQNWtBelpqRGtSUUZMdy1vblBhcnUyRWNhUGMyNlFuQzVaMkM?oc=5)[Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQVmhvUm5CcW1VaFVfbGtpdjFsTEFmWlZHY1FXdC1jdFQzY2xIMFh1cmRzWUk3Skk5WVFXNGpCRVdpZUVTOXZONndqVnhveGgwR0NLc0dLb09henI1YmdCRS1RV0Jnd1BIVFc1VExaNDJzVmR4OVhEaDNVSEU5LTRXeExMRjE?oc=5). A Commerzbank board reshuffle is due in early 2027 [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQekFrdGJNa2ZHbFVGR1N5a0NqS0lDeVJGVFhjcElXdW9PVTJnSEtPRzRwUGpKSVZzcE5DbkcxNDl3SGcyZV9XZ3BBUDAwWEZLajMzUElFLXJNdHdUU0RnRmhqWHFsLVdicmxFRHlyLUdFMFFiajNuYlM3anNFTGtjRTVGVE9tcXlsTnR2bHd3eGJqaWFyN3pxd2RwaERJQU9UMHVqSXltRkt6SGoxSFk2UQ?oc=5). If you bank with both, expect them to merge relationship coverage and credit limits, so review how much you concentrate with the combined group. - **Carrier:** It has launched a smart thermostat with Universal Electronics that uses InteliSense technology to improve comfort and service [Business Wire](https://news.google.?oc=5). This is product news, but it adds to the connected-device estate, which comes up again in The brief. - **Barclays:** It has opened an office in Saudi Arabia even as Houthi attacks ramp up [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQdk9LQjAyZDFCZFBPdHoxMVB2cVV5LXFZOFAxVm5jS2ZFVThkZ29hSUVabGgxbFJpZzBnaVVtQUlnSmRKcWNDbVBVeFVSNWFBWk4tTFFwZWZ5QlFZQVFIeGpsRndoOFpMay1zRGJabE5aTl9yUmRkamFTajBUYk5NMk5GV2ZTNk1FOVM4Wk95NEx3OGk4bjFNNHkwTlNPSk5mcnJjLUNMNWZNNnRzNzBwUXd0Zw?oc=5). That signals a commitment to the Gulf, which is worth knowing if Carrier needs banking coverage in the region. ## The brief - **Canada's Real-Time Rail payments system has finally launched after years of delays** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48725/canadas-real-time-payments-system-launches?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). Ask your Canadian banks when corporate access and ISO 20022 data will be available for supplier and intercompany payments. - **Tradeweb and BNY are teaming up to widen the investment options on Tradeweb's ICD Portal** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/111616/tradeweb-collaborates-with-bny-to-expand-icd-portal-investment-options?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). ICD is a multi-fund platform corporate treasurers use to trade money market funds, so it is worth benchmarking against your current portal for fund range and costs. - **France has accused Iran of cyber attacks on supermarket refrigerators that destroyed food and triggered fires** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/176ad787-59af-4900-9efc-8b6f9a247255?syn-25a6b1a6=1). Connected cooling equipment is now a state-level target, so cyber risk and product liability belong in the risk register and the insurance review. - **Crédit Agricole has proposed merging its Italian operations with Banco BPM** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48721/crdit-agricole-proposes-merger-with-banco-bpm-to-create-new-italian-bank?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). The deal would create Italy's third-largest bank, which means further consolidation among European banks and fewer counterparties to choose from. ## Rates & FX - **SONIA jumped 25bp to 3.9824%, reflecting the Bank of England's hike.** Sterling deposits and SONIA-linked borrowing reprice straight away, so check that GBP cash sweeps and facilities are picking up the new rate. - **US yields rose ahead of today's inflation data** [WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOU0N5Skk5WEFjeFZaU2hkdnczUWd0Y2QzNEFJNFF0Mk9UdTd0LUhCRGI4aVBldGpNaDRoWFdJT0xDcldjX0p0OG5yS1lBQktuSVo3alNaTkVSNmI3WWZ2M25WSnJ4Y1BkTGEzM05NamtJYlBQSk1pdVdMNHg2MTJVd0Yxc29Xc3ZOUkFPYkJxdWQtU3BINU42NjVlSl85Z0ZG?oc=5). The 2-year is 4.56% (+5bp) and the 10-year is 4.88% (+2bp). SOFR has eased to 3.89%, down 6bp on the week. The NY Fed's consumer survey shows a steady inflation outlook [Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOUDdpRDZLb3pTaElmb1JRdHJfV3VrMlVUMnVOQkZKaC1IODFFaWlRU0o4REFuTEVZclFxdHRKNzZod19jU2NrdUI5T2luMWdnYjZReEpldmdCb2U5U3dkRXhTZ1hsTWtIZnh1cnZqMjFQUmloVkdVeGZCb1ZLVllqcjBuaXJtN0luUWNzZUo4aTIwS2lyNU1BYnRnRzc2WHBGaEc5LTBTMmZ5ZkdfTlo0Sk5IYw?oc=5). - **FX.** EUR/USD is 1.1193 (+0.25% on the day, -0.21% on the week). USD/MXN fell 0.48% to 18.614, so the peso is firmer again. USD/CNY is 6.6728 (+0.37% on the week). EUR/GBP is flat at 0.8343. - **US CPI today at 13:30 Dublin.** Headline is forecast at +0.3% (previous +0.6%) and core at +0.2%. A hot print would firm up a December Fed hike and push up the dollar and short-term USD rates, so it may be worth holding big USD hedges or deposit placements until after the release. ## Also worth knowing - **PNC now offers corporate clients incoming stablecoin payments through Coinbase** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48728/pnc-launches-stablecoin-payments-for-corporate-clients?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). - **HVAC distributor Watsco posted record revenue in an upbeat quarter** [ACHR News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxObmktZm9oWkRpWkFxX2xPRUJOM0FXVnJhYk1FU003d3B6V2w3c0xGc0h5ck9qUmM3OEF6RWw2bXBjUXhpdVc0YkczWHdDc0ZqWDNsQjNjcU0wUVd1T1FPS2NGcTQzMmNfUnpncXFIYjhNUDQ4bnFWY1hoZ3RnNFFITDFreWFHNEx4djhvTWZ2ZUlOQThicVdJSWV4eGxmMG8?oc=5). That points to healthy demand in the US channel. - **Nvidia shares fell as its board investigates an alleged Chinese spy scandal** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/fa3b0a35-1aa9-4f31-97b4-e4c599e3e654?syn-25a6b1a6=1). Investors are moving into defensive stocks on fears the AI bull market is over [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/efe9653b-6802-485e-8eae-97fa2e6df770?syn-25a6b1a6=1). - **ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with Caracas as it explores a return to Venezuela** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/cd3b2969-9c58-404a-a80a-c823754899ef?syn-25a6b1a6=1). ## Worth thinking about US manufacturing investment has tripled since 2020, but capacity has grown only 1.5% [Manufacturing Dive](https://www.manufacturingdive.com/spons/expectations-vs-reality-the-disconnect-between-manufacturing-investment-a/873275/). For FP&A, that is a useful challenge to put to capex business cases. How much of Carrier's plant spending adds output, and how much just replaces or upgrades what is already there? The answer should shape the cash plan for 2027.
